name: model_op_add_rms_norm_bias
description: In-place fused residual add + RMSNorm with optional bias (FlagGems-vllm PR #700, add_rms_norm_bias). x [..., N] and residual [..., N] float16/float32 with identical shapes, weight [N] and optional bias [N] same dtype, eps float. Computes x = x + residual in float32, normalizes by rsqrt(mean(x^2) + eps), scales by weight, adds bias when given, and writes the normalized result back into x while writing the pre-normalization sum back into residual. normalized_shape is taken from weight.shape. Both x and residual are modified in place and returned as (x, residual) by alias.
